trailhead.label: Terenten village centre, bus stop Terenten Dorf (official start)

cautions: About 400 m on the Pustertaler Sonnenstraße (SP40) through the village, with no pavement.
Short steps with a handrail and an eroded gully by the earth pyramids.
Meadow paths and farm tracks past a working farm.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
